items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: See I had been hanging around Joe Zawinul.

ctx.x: That was his name, Padwa. P-A-D-W-A I think. Cat named – a piano player comes to my class named Charles Jordan turned me on to Padwa. So I started taking with Padwa, and then I was having my class one day, and I decided I’m gonna start looking for another piano teacher, ‘cause Padwa had passed away I think. So I went to a cat on 57th street. I had an audition, nice cat. But one of my students, who now lives in Madrid, named Joshua, he said, “Barry, maybe you aught to go to my piano teacher ‘cause he’s different.…
That’s what Joe said? Or that was the piano teacher?
